title.zh: 美国联邦法院初步裁定Kalshi体育事件合约或属互换
title.en: 美国联邦法院初步裁定Kalshi体育事件合约或属互换

current_state.zh: A US federal court in Illinois partially granted a preliminary injunction blocking Illinois from imposing sports-betting licensing and criminal penalties on Kalshi's sports event contracts, holding the contracts are likely swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act and thus likely preempted by federal law.
current_state.en: A US federal court in Illinois partially granted a preliminary injunction blocking Illinois from imposing sports-betting licensing and criminal penalties on Kalshi's sports event contracts, holding the contracts are likely swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act and thus likely preempted by federal law.
